title: Camera never received — signature is not mine
body: I ordered a mirrorless camera for $780.00 on Oct 20. Tracking says it was delivered Oct 24 and signed for, but I was at work all day and that signature is absolutely not mine — it doesn't even look like my name. I checked with everyone in my building. For a purchase this large I expect a real investigation, not a form letter. I will not accept being out $780 for a package handed to a stranger.
